notes.title: [UPDATE] Chained Backrooms v1.0.5
notes.content:
Update v1.0.5 is now in-game!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493047/522c93ddd4ac47b6203128b765bb65d919891bf6.png

List of changes:



 Updated game balance - now items in the shop (improvements, etc) cost much cheaper
 Increased the timer by 20% - now more time to collect items and explore the location
 Removed the location with the rotating beam
 Fixed (hopefully) the problem with bad loading of costume colour in players

notes.title: [RELEASE] CHAINED BACKROOMS - available now at 15% off
notes.content:
Chained Backrooms — NOW AVAILABLE ON STEAM WITH 15% OFF

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493047/3d26e39450c866930b234f69b9a99a3c9b98ca46.png

Huge thanks to everyone who joined the beta and played the demo — your support helped bring this game to release ❤️


 Co-op survival where you're chained to other players  
 Procedurally generated Backrooms levels  
 Find and sell valuable items  
 Merchants, upgrades, and a real race against time  


Bring your friends and dive into the BACKROOMS!

notes.title: [Demo] Demo v1.3.4 released
notes.content:
Demo Version v1.3.4 is now in the game!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493047/074e78c5ef0c35aca406b8c5afa8f544470453ac.png"]
Changelog:

Gameplay


 Save system reworked (previously, a bug sometimes prevented the game from saving when transitioning from the Game Level to the Shop Level)

notes.title: [Demo] Demo v1.3.1 released
notes.content:
Demo v1.3.1 is already in the game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493047/2b1b9e3ba9ae94f1db2c3a3f8be1cf242ac1c23d.png

List of changes:

UI

 The server list has been redesigned, it now shows the game state and the current day
 Reduced VHS effect in the main menu by players' requests
 Added microphone indication in game
 Added animations to the interface when changing XP, Stamina and Flashlight Charge


Gameplay

 Changed level generation. On the first level now will not be able to appear a large room
 Added ability to scan monsters
 Fix for chain dragging, to which the player is not attached
 Now ‘Old Bag’ item does not eat items when moving them around the inventory
 Added sound to torch


Level Design

 Slightly changed the starting location
 Added a secret room. You can find it in the Shop location



Shop

 Now when you buy improvements they are automatically applied

notes.title: [Steam Next Fest] Full Demo-version release
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We have released a demo version of our game Chained Backrooms, so far the game has implemented many game mechanics:


 Physical Chain
 Multiplayer
 Infinite Gameplay
 Procedural Generation
 Voice Chat
 Character Upgrade System
 and more


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493047/3a7079947ddbbc99695dcfc9d465164eb50adf8c.png

We also want to let you know that we will be taking an active part in Next Fest, which will take place from 9 to 16 June

This is a great opportunity given to us by Steam to introduce the game to a wider audience.

At this point, the game is almost out of beta and we are ready to release a demo of our game.

Many thanks to our BETA-TESTERS who have been testing our game for a month and finding various bugs! Thanks to them we fixed a lot of bugs and now the game is much better!

Our FREE demo will be released soon, stay tuned for its release!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493047/85f1d3c8a724ed4aff2d74d497ca1241cc70f649.png

To keep up to date with all the news about the development of the game, visit our Discord server! There you will have the opportunity to chat with the developers and other players!
